description: This file is a shell script for testing 'git pack-objects' functionality related to object filtering, including various filters such as blob:none, blob:limit, sparse:path, sparse:oid, and handling of missing objects. It sets up git repositories, creates commits and objects, and runs tests to verify pack-objects behavior with different filters and options.

methods.description: Defines a passing test case with description.
